name: Kitsune heavy punch
notes: Uppercut clip 35 frames, hit 11-14. Deviation from C8 10/4/20: recovery +1 (clip 35 frames). Hitbox rises (y 190-320) as an uppercut; anti_air flag is a proposal from the box shape. Hurtbox: the E5 standing body 90x360 for the whole move; the wide sleeves are NOT added (they are cloth, not body); only the bare striking limb gets an extra hurtbox while it is extended. Hitstun, blockstun and pushback are placeholders on the Ryo fixture scale (not in rules.md); damage is the C8 number (no Kitsune table exists).
